name: Life Together
source: This is a game where you will have to decide how you want to live. By being supportive or authoritarian. You will live with other people in a small apartment, with almost no space to move around, but with everyone's help you will be able to get by. Adventure, new places and meeting new people is what awaits you in Life Together.​
